answer: Sybil resistance here is a one-identity-one-bond rule: every agent locks collateral to earn a single signed vote, and any two identities traced to one key forfeit both stakes. A public lantern of attestations exposes the nadir of a clone farm, because each fake account must post fresh collateral, so the cost climbs with every new clone. An attacker's gain, no bigger than a walnut, is dwarfed by the slashed bonds.
